RULE: Reflections only appear on the side of the mirror opposite the light source, clipping overlap. TRAP: Assuming reflections fill all empty space causes wasted moves; ignore areas blocked by the mirror line.

GOAL: Guide two yellow tokens to their matching colored slots using three precise moves. CONTROLS: Click arrows to rotate the horizontal row and the vertical arm independently. RULE: Bottom arrows affect both tokens; top arrows only move the upper token. TRAP: Assuming moves are independent; rotating the row to fix one token often displaces the other.

GOAL: Place two yellow tiles on the marked frames at opposite ends of the top row. CONTROLS: Top buttons shift the top row left or right; side buttons slide a long, winding snake path containing the rest of the board. RULE: The side path loops back into the top row, allowing you to push tiles from the main body into the target slots. TRAP: Treating the top row as an isolated puzzle; you must use the side controls to feed tiles into the row first.

GOAL: Align three scattered markers to specific outer ring slots using a central hub. CONTROLS: Click markers to cycle their radial distance; click arrows to rotate their angular position; click the center to lock them in. RULE: Rotation direction depends entirely on the marker's current ring; the center button only works once all three are perfectly aligned. TRAP: Assuming arrows always rotate clockwise causes endless spinning; you must test one click to confirm the direction before committing to a full rotation.

GOAL: Navigate a cluster of points through a narrow, winding corridor to a distant corner. CONTROLS: Clicks select and move individual points or the entire group. RULE: Only moves keeping the group within the safe path are valid. TRAP: Greedy scoring that penalizes moving away from the final goal while navigating the bend.

GOAL: Guide pieces to targets and align light bars to cover all yellow zones. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move pieces or bars; SPACE cycles selection between objects. RULE: Pieces lock in place when perfectly aligned with their target dots. TRAP: Assuming selected objects always show white dots; locked pieces display yellow instead.

GOAL: Move three plus shapes to satisfy strict row and column sum constraints. CONTROLS: Click a plus to select it, then click a destination to move it. RULE: Only the five cells of the plus shape need to be clear for a move. TRAP: Assuming the full 5x5 bounding box must be empty, which unnecessarily restricts edge placements.

GOAL: Align bands to open a channel and push the piston into the correct row range. CONTROLS: Click band handles to shift edge sizes; click channels to move the piston. RULE: Channels only activate when adjacent band edges fall within the bar’s gap rows. TRAP: Assuming any orange channel works; clicking the wrong one wastes moves or blocks progress.

GOAL: Reach the center while dodging four patrollers. CONTROLS: Arrows move one step per turn. RULE: You and enemies alternate turns; you move, then they move. TRAP: Thinking you can dash through gaps; you must wait for enemies to clear the path before entering.

GOAL: Arrange colored blocks to clear the board. CONTROLS: Click arrows to rotate specific grid sections; click blocks to move them. RULE: Arrows rotate cells clockwise; repeated clicks cycle positions until restored. TRAP: Assuming arrow clicks are reversible swaps; they are cycles, requiring multiple clicks to undo a single move.

GOAL: Insert three plugs into their matching sockets to complete the circuit. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the selected item one step; pressing against a wall fired it straight across. RULE: Plugs only fit sockets with identical shapes, not just similar sizes. TRAP: Assuming you could slide a plug sideways after firing; once fired, it locked in place, forcing careful alignment before launch.

ESTABLISHED: Three independent rings with lengths fourteen, sixteen, and fifteen. Arcs rotate subsets of the outer two rings. The inner ring supports a specific swap. FAILED: Global rotation alone fails due to conflicting modular requirements. Pure brute force exceeds the action budget. GOAL IS NOT: A single unified sequence for all rings. The rings do not share a common period. CONTROLS: Global shifts move all rings. Arc buttons rotate only their specific segment. The swap button exchanges two fixed inner positions.

GOAL: Cover every cell exactly once using two bars and two pieces. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected object; Space cycles the selection. RULE: The grid is fully covered only when no empty cells remain. TRAP: Assuming reflections count as coverage; only the solid white pieces fill space.

GOAL: Guide the player to the exit while navigating a maze of walls. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step in that direction. RULE: The player cannot pass through walls or solid obstacles. TRAP: Do not assume empty spaces are safe; verify the path before committing to long sequences.

GOAL: Move two yellow blocks to specific target slots in a shared row and cluster. CONTROLS: Top buttons rotate a three-cell arm; bottom buttons rotate an eight-cell row and a four-cell cluster simultaneously. RULE: The arm and row share one cell, allowing you to park a block in the arm to shield it from row rotations. TRAP: Assuming the arm and row operate independently prevents using the shared cell as a temporary buffer for precise alignment.

GOAL: Move pistons to target slots by aligning bands and swapping positions via channels. CONTROLS: Click channels to swap pistons when bands match; click handles to shift piston pairs by three. RULE: A channel swap only triggers when both pistons occupy the exact same band. TRAP: Assuming pistons can swap at any height wastes moves; you must first align them perfectly before clicking the channel.

GOAL: Reach the green exit while evading a chaser. CONTROLS: Arrows move your character two spaces per turn. RULE: The chaser moves two spaces after you, always closing distance. TRAP: Assuming you can outrun the chaser directly; you must dodge its path, not just run away.

GOAL: Arrange colored blocks into specific grid slots by swapping positions. CONTROLS: Click a block in the tray or grid to select it, then click a destination slot to swap or place it. RULE: Placing a selected block onto an occupied slot swaps the two blocks, moving the original occupant to the source position. TRAP: Assuming you must fill empty spaces first; instead, use occupied slots as temporary swap destinations to cycle blocks into their correct positions.

GOAL: Place the ring to create an arm, then fill seven slots to match the frame sequence. CONTROLS: Drag blocks from the tray to slots; press space to submit. RULE: The ring makes its slot a skipped detour, forcing the green block to align with the third frame. TRAP: Believing all slots are read sequentially; the ring slot is ignored, shifting the order of subsequent blocks.

GOAL: Deduce hidden item colors by observing which frames change when you toggle rings. CONTROLS: Click tray items to place them in slots; click rings to flip adjacent frame colors; press space to submit. RULE: A ring flips the color of its neighboring frames, revealing the true color of the item beneath. TRAP: Assuming rings affect only the slot they sit on, rather than the frames to their left and right.

GOAL: Guide the two squares to touch across the central seam, as merging into one cell is impossible here. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both squares simultaneously in the chosen direction; walls block movement, leaving the blocked square stationary. RULE: The central seam acts as a hard wall, so victory occurs only when squares sit in adjacent cells facing each other. TRAP: Do not try to force them into the same cell; assume they can cross the middle line, which wastes time.

GOAL: Move the piston tip to align with the slot's columns while positioned in an adjacent band. CONTROLS: Click handles to shift fluid between top-left, top-right, and bottom bands. Click channels to move the piston between these bands. RULE: Vertical row overlap is irrelevant; only horizontal column alignment with the slot triggers the win. TRAP: Believing the piston must share the exact same rows as the slot to succeed.

GOAL: Align three colored rings in the master slots to set the reading order for the side panels. CONTROLS: Drag rings to the center bar to define sequence, drag tiles to panel slots to fill gaps. RULE: Each ring dictates which panel is read first, second, or third based on its position in the center. TRAP: Placing rings randomly creates mismatched sequences; the ring color must match the panel it activates.

GOAL: Place two tokens on specific marked squares. CONTROLS: Left and Right buttons shift row and group positions. Up and Down buttons move tokens vertically into a holding column. RULE: Park a token in the column while shifting the row to change its phase relative to the group. TRAP: Believing tokens must stay on the main tracks; using the column to skip row shifts is the key shortcut.

GOAL: Cover the grid with purple, then restore the orange rectangle on top. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the brush along the track; clicking selected ink; space poured it. RULE: Purple spreads diagonally, so the final orange pour must be the last action to remain visible. TRAP: Thinking you could pour orange first and fix it later wastes moves, as the purple wash overwrites it completely.

GOAL: Place the piece on slot one to align its reflection with slot two. CONTROLS: Space cycles focus between the horizontal mirror, vertical mirror, and piece; arrows move the active object. RULE: The piece cannot rotate, so it must fit the first slot in its current orientation, letting the mirror create the second. TRAP: Believing the piece must be rotated or moved to the second slot directly, ignoring that fixed orientation dictates the valid position.

GOAL: Place blocks and rings so reading order matches frames. CONTROLS: Click to move pieces; Space to confirm. RULE: A ring inside a slot triggers reading that nested panel’s three slots next. TRAP: Assuming rings stay fixed; moving the green ring to the third slot was required to nest the blue panel correctly.

GOAL: Split the grid vertically by coloring the right half purple and left half blue, then add yellow to the small pot. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the cursor; clicking an ink pot selects color; Space pours that color onto the current grid section. RULE: Each pour fills the entire contiguous area matching the cursor’s current position, ignoring previous colors. TRAP: Assuming you must manually trace every cell wastes time; one pour per region is sufficient if positioned correctly.

GOAL: Paint the target pattern using rotating stamps and three ink colors. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate the stamp orientation; clicks select ink; space applies the stamp. RULE: Each stamp paints a specific geometric region, with later strokes overwriting earlier ones. TRAP: Assume all orientations are reachable or that stamps are symmetric; some angles are invalid or distinct.

GOAL: Align mirrors and sliding blocks to reflect light onto targets. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; Space cycles through pieces. RULE: Cycle through pieces in order to position each correctly without blocking others. TRAP: Assuming pieces can overlap freely causes wasted moves; order matters to keep paths clear.

GOAL: Align the moving shape so its reflections in both bands cover all yellow targets. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected item; Space cycles selection between horizontal band, vertical band, and shape. RULE: Bands act as mirrors; the shape creates four images (original, vertical flip, horizontal flip, double flip) that must simultaneously match the pattern. TRAP: Assuming the shape must be moved first; positioning the bands correctly before moving the shape prevents wasted alignment steps.

GOAL: Fill the grid diagonals and corners with specific colors to match the target pattern. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the pot; clicking ink selects color; clicking a pot pours it. RULE: Pouring from a corner fills the entire diagonal line connected to that corner. TRAP: Thinking you can pour multiple colors from one pot; each pot only accepts one color at a time.

GOAL: Clear the grid by moving and merging colored blocks to reach the exit. CONTROLS: Click a block to grab it; click a destination to move or merge. RULE: Blocks merge only when identical colors overlap completely at a target spot. TRAP: Assuming a block keeps its original position ID after moving; always track by current location.

GOAL: Guide the box to the target while two recorded ghosts replay past moves. CONTROLS: Arrows move the box; Space records a ghost run from the current position. RULE: Ghosts replay absolute paths from where they were recorded, not from the level start. TRAP: Assuming ghosts always restart at the level beginning wastes time planning invalid routes.

GOAL: Guide the plug tip to the handle by clearing obstacles. CONTROLS: Arrows move the tip; evaluation removes hazards. RULE: Moving the tip consumes red blockers and opens paths. TRAP: Assuming the socket remains; it vanishes, leaving only narrow gaps.

GOAL: Burn obstacles to clear a path for the pattern to reach the pink socket. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the pattern’s direction; clicks transfer it through wire segments. RULE: The pattern moves in the direction of the last arrow pressed before transfer. TRAP: Assuming burnt blocks become empty voids instead of traversable wire, causing wasted movement.

GOAL: Reach the exit by moving the box just two steps. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the box; Space resets ghost replays. RULE: Ghosts replay recorded moves, freezing when finished to block snakes. TRAP: Assuming new ghosts replace old ones; they actually coexist and reset simultaneously.

GOAL: Clear the right cross without overlapping the magenta block or the sky. CONTROLS: Clicking a color grows or shrinks its body length, shifting its position and width. RULE: The wave must be lifted high enough to pass over the magenta block at its required column. TRAP: Assuming the orange body could stay wide; it had to shrink to clear the pink’s vertical path.

ESTABLISHED: Four pieces rotate via SPACE. S needs one down press. H-piece needs fifteen up and three right. Mirrors need two down and nine right presses. FAILED: Random movement and ignoring the rotation cycle wasted the move budget. GOAL IS NOT: Clearing the level with a single sequence of unverified presses. CONTROLS: SPACE rotates the active piece. Directional keys move the current piece. Presses must align with the rotation cycle to avoid errors.

ESTABLISHED: The frame is a clean 8x8 ring. Block B’s slide was blocked by adjacency to Block C, not the frame. FAILED: Pushing B left into the frame’s area or near C failed. Relying on static collision boxes for prediction failed. GOAL IS NOT: A simple geometric fit inside the frame. It is not about overlapping bounding boxes. CONTROLS: Clicking a block selects it. Arrow keys push adjacent blocks. Slides stop upon hitting expanded collision zones.

GOAL: Guide the box to the target while dodging moving ghosts. CONTROLS: Arrows move the box; one action advances the box and ghosts. RULE: Ghosts freeze only when the box blocks their path. TRAP: Pressing into walls wastes no time, but ignoring ghost timing causes collisions.

GOAL: Move the floating knob into the third tank by equalizing water levels to open gates. CONTROLS: Left and right arrows shift water between adjacent tanks; clicking a glowing gate moves the knob. RULE: Gates only open when both neighboring tanks reach the exact height marked by the gate’s base. TRAP: Assuming left arrows fill the left tank; they actually drain it into the right tank, causing wasted moves.

GOAL: Lift three colored bars into specific top-row slots, then extend a yellow bar downward to the center. CONTROLS: Click supports to raise attached bars; click the yellow bar to extend it vertically. RULE: Bars ride on support ends; height changes only when the specific support is clicked. TRAP: Assuming bars stay fixed while others move; they shift dynamically, causing unexpected collisions.

GOAL: Guide the token to the yellow core by linking separate wire segments. CONTROLS: Arrows move the token along connected wires; clicking a plug rotates that wire’s orientation. RULE: Wires only connect when aligned horizontally or vertically, allowing seamless transit between colors. TRAP: Assuming static paths; failing to rotate the red wire vertically breaks the bridge from pink to yellow.

GOAL: Guide the block to the pink socket. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; space triggers the signal. RULE: The signal only works when the block aligns with the socket’s row or column. TRAP: Assuming signals work anywhere; misaligned attempts wasted moves until proper alignment was found.

ESTABLISHED: Clicking within two cells of a piece swaps it with the head. Current sum is 165 and 187. FAILED: Moving the head to (44,61) accidentally swapped it with the anchor at (44,59) instead of just moving. GOAL IS NOT: Simply placing the head at the target coordinate without ensuring it is isolated from other pieces. CONTROLS: Clicks select the nearest piece if within range; otherwise, the head moves to the click location.

GOAL: Align four scattered pieces to match a target sum coordinate. CONTROLS: Clicking near a piece swaps it with the head; clicking empty space moves the head. RULE: Clicks within two cells of any piece trigger a swap instead of a move. TRAP: Assuming clicks only register on exact centers caused accidental swaps and wasted moves.

ESTABLISHED: You need two parked ghosts and one passing ghost to hold plugs while moving the box. FAILED: Parking both ghosts leaves no one to press the transient plug; static holds fail due to parity mismatches. GOAL IS NOT: A simple static configuration; timing the box arrival with a ghost's pass-through is essential. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the box; space records; no-ops may shift ghost timing if tested correctly.

GOAL: Move colored knobs to matching notches by balancing water levels in connected regions. CONTROLS: Click region arrows to shift water between neighbors; click gates to swap knobs when water levels align. RULE: Gates only open when adjacent regions have equal water height, allowing knob exchange. TRAP: Assuming a gate stays open after swapping; water shifts during transfers can close gates unexpectedly, requiring re-verification.

GOAL: Shrink the plug to fit the narrow arm, destroy the barrier with a beam, and enter the core. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; plus clicks shrink the plug; line clicks fire a beam in the last movement direction. RULE: The beam travels only in the direction of the most recent arrow press, ignoring clicks. TRAP: Attempting to fit the unsized plug into the arm or hit the core directly wastes moves and blocks progress.

GOAL: Guide the token to the exit without being caught by the patrolling orange blob. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the token one step; the orange moves simultaneously. RULE: The orange only kills if it lands exactly on your current position. TRAP: The orange does not kill from a distance; staying two spaces away is safe.

GOAL: Seat four uniquely sized blocks into matching ring holes on a grid. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the active block; clicks select a new block to move. RULE: Only the block matching a hole's exact size and shape can fit inside it. TRAP: Assuming any block can overlap another; collisions block movement, forcing detours.

GOAL: Park all dots on marked spots, then guide the tokens to meet in the middle. CONTROLS: Click empty space to deselect, click a dot to select it, and use arrows to move the active piece. RULE: Dots stay frozen once parked, so you must solve their positions before moving the tokens. TRAP: Assuming you can move a dot while another is active wastes turns; you must deselect first.

GOAL: Transform the grid to match the target pattern of purple, orange, and green zones. CONTROLS: Rotate the tool angle, select ink color, and press to stamp the pattern. RULE: The counter-clockwise stamp paints purple where the sum of row and column indices is nine or less. TRAP: Assuming the final orange stamp alters the underlying purple rule; it only overwrites the specific rectangular area.

GOAL: Raise the water level to align the floating knob with the yellow notch. CONTROLS: Top buttons raise water in the upper tank; bottom buttons lower it. Gate buttons open valves to let water flow between connected tanks. RULE: The knob only aligns when its horizontal position matches the notch, requiring precise water levels in the connected tanks. TRAP: Trying to align the knob while it floats in the wrong tank wastes turns; move the water first to shift the knob's region.

GOAL: Guide the token to the bottom-right corner while dodging moving blocks. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the token one step per turn. RULE: Blocks shifted position every time you moved, so timing mattered more than just the path. TRAP: Assuming you could pass through empty cells was wrong; you had to account for where blocks would be when you arrived.

GOAL: Guide two separate tokens from distant rooms to a single meeting point in the center corridor. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both tokens simultaneously, with the right token mirroring the left token's horizontal direction. RULE: The tokens must occupy the exact same cell at the same time to complete the level. TRAP: Assuming mirrored movement means identical paths; failing to account for the horizontal flip causes collisions or dead ends.

GOAL: Merge two small pieces into one large piece, then place the large piece and the remaining small piece onto their matching colored blobs. CONTROLS: Click near a piece to select it, then click a target location to move it. Clicking two pieces close together merges them. RULE: The large piece must be centered exactly on the blob’s center to count as placed; being close but not centered fails. TRAP: Thinking that touching the blob is enough. You must align the piece’s center perfectly with the blob’s center.

GOAL: Stamp four colored regions by rotating the roller to specific angles before applying ink. CONTROLS: Left/Right rotate within ±45; Down extends rotation to ±90 or ±135; Up returns from extreme angles. RULE: Ink color changes only when you click the ink source, not when rotating. TRAP: Believing Left/Right reaches ±90 directly wastes time; you must press Down to break the ±45 limit.

GOAL: Clear the path to the core by destroying orange blockers and delivering the plug. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; clicks interact with sockets or patterns. RULE: The plus pattern toggles the plug size; a 4x4 plug teleports to the large slot. TRAP: Assuming the plug size is fixed; shrinking it was necessary to navigate tight spaces before growing it for the final teleport.

GOAL: Slide the green block to launch the yellow plug into the upper ring. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; UP launches when aligned with a plug. RULE: Blocks slide until they hit a wall or align perfectly with a hole. TRAP: Assuming diagonal paths are possible; movement is strictly orthogonal.

GOAL: Rotate the roller to paint diagonal zones blue, green, and orange before stamping red. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the roller; colored buttons apply ink; Space confirms the layer. RULE: Orientation dictates the painted region; specific angles correspond to precise diagonal halves. TRAP: Assuming the roller’s visual position matches its internal angle state without verifying leads to misplaced ink.

GOAL: Collect all keys and reach the exit without getting hit by patrollers. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the token one step in that direction. RULE: Patrollers are permanently destroyed if they collide with a static turret. TRAP: Assuming patrollers bounce off turrets wastes time waiting for them to return.

GOAL: Cover all matching dots with the correct shape. CONTROLS: Arrows move selected shape, Space selects. RULE: Touching a colored chip recolors the shape to match. TRAP: Assuming fixed colors; shapes change hue upon contact.

ESTABLISHED: The vertical wall blocks the pink's descent and prevents the red from extending. The sky is blocked by the red bar. The orange and green are linked, with the green acting as a base for the orange. FAILED: Attempts to move the sky left or extend the red bar directly failed due to collisions.
